name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois's motorsport journey began in his childhood, fueled by watching Alain Prost dominate Formula 1. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from École Polytechnique, specializing in aerodynamics. His early career was spent with smaller racing teams, where he honed his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics, before moving to McLaren Racing. 

Known for his meticulous approach, Jean-Pierre excels at identifying subtle performance gains through rigorous testing and simulations. He is driven by a relentless pursuit of improvement and fosters a collaborative environment within the engineering team, mentoring junior members. He's particularly adept at bridging the gap between simulations and on-track performance, ensuring the team's strategies are both theoretically sound and practically effective. 

He is known for his ability to maintain composure under pressure, a vital asset during high-stakes races. His focus on precise communication and clarity has earned him the respect of drivers and mechanics alike.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on drinking espresso at exactly 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
Taps his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
